12/10/2026 is used for new UI fixes with a recorded completion date. The MCQ fix uses 10/10/2026. Earlier unknown dates remain blank rather than being invented.

Bugs 12, 49 and 50 have a temporary scheduling workaround. Bug 58 needs provider report follow-up. Their original statuses are preserved and their notes explicitly state they are not confirmed fixed.
Other rows
Rows outside the reviewed fixes retain the supplied developer values. No new fix is claimed for them.
